item.title: City council looking for ways to help kick-start apartment construction
item.description: Brantford councillors have asked city staff to come up with ways to kick-start apartment projects that have been approved for construction but have not yet been built.

item.title: Brantford police charge woman, 39, in connection with 2005 death of newborn 'Baby Parker'

The accused, who lived in Brantford at the time of the incident, has been charged with indignity to a body and concealing the body of a child.
